note: Sections only, from eval --bars/--lines. The 4-line hook (sung 6-11 times) over the full beat = chorus; the soft bass-less opening with the hook = intro. Loud stretches with only a one-line chop = drops. Verse 2 (unique lines) starts over the full beat, then thins out; one-bar bass gaps mark the phrase ends before choruses and drops.
